title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one plant phase cycle has an explicit maturity-and-flower-fall boundary
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Extending the already proposed IDEA680 day/night flower mechanism, complete Pliny XIII.107–110 supplies a concrete head/leaf/flower account with an until-ripe-and-flower-fall boundary, seed processing, and a separate Euphrates submergence report. Try a recurring phase-guard and a separately scoped life-stage boundary in complete admitted f2v, with only conditional later f68r2 comparison. The source bounds its narrated recurrence; an absolute no-opening-after-maturity rule for every head or generation is NOT supplied. No lotus identification or W96 repair is claimed.

design.mechanism: A repeated astronomical phase guards a plant-state predicate within the described life-stage interval. Head/flower identity is explicit in the authored account, not inferred merely from repetitions. The source names both maturation and white-flower fall at the interval boundary. A strict cessation rule for an individual, or for every head of a plant, would be a separate stronger C0 assumption. If seed processing is selected, head/seed membership and root versus seed food must remain distinct.
design.unit: Complete existing f2v.1–4 from W96,29ZL/30IT groups, with the exact IT o dain split. Optional later comparison is the two complete already-owned f68r2 luminary rings .6/.31, not unadmitted star labels. Neither f2v water-plant identity nor a solar word is assumed as observation.
design.contrast: A phase-indexed account with an explicitly scoped maturity-and-flower-fall boundary versus a static quality list, independent carriers at every mention, or an indefinitely repeated universal daily claim.
design.prediction: Under a constructed reading, repeated phase expressions must use a shared guard and declared carrier scope. The boundary expression must account for BOTH maturation and flower fall, rather than a free expiry duration or silently equating maturity with every future closure. A solar phase expression reused elsewhere retains a temporal argument, not a plant-name alias.
design.scope: New source-grounded C0 story option; no target forms are assigned meanings. It is not a W96 outcome or a reopening justified by fewer stipulated contradictions.

historical_source.work: Pliny Naturalis historia XIII.107–110, entire herb-and-root account as printed, preceded by the explicit same-name/different-tree boundary.
historical_source.layer: Ancient Latin preserved in electronic edition, not a newly dated medieval pictorial witness. No medieval illustration or modern species identification acquired.
local_sequence: 107 explicitly changes from the preceding tree to a same-named herb in Egyptian wet ground after Nile retreat; bean-like stem/leaves, poppy-like head and millet-like grains are comparisons, not those taxa.

108 heads are heaped to rot; grains are separated by washing, dried, pounded and used for bread. Sunset heads close and are covered by leaves; sunrise opens them donec maturescant flosque, qui est candidus, decidat. The narrated recurrence is bounded by ripening plus white-flower fall, not a universal denial of later heads or generations.

109 a separately reported Euphrates case adds head AND flower going beneath the water until midnight, then gradually rising and emerging/opening at sunrise. This geographical attribution and the actual submergence sequence are not silently assigned to every Egyptian plant.
110 the root is quince-sized with a dark rind and white interior; raw, water-cooked or ember-cooked food and pig-fattening peelings. Root, grain and flower remain different part roles.

positive_existing_target_constraints: W96 preserves the complete f2v paragraph: chor occurs three times, sho twice, daiin twice; none of these facts is new or semantically interpreted here.
The last line is sho cholo cheor chodaiin. The earlier form is chodain, NOT the same complete word. An apparent choda(i)in family is an unproved segmentation, not exact repetition.

The complete f68r2 pair has8 versus12/11 groups and materially different continuations. It cannot be treated as the same proposition with one name replaced; source sunrise/sunset does not assign okoaiin=Sun.
additional_assumptions: That f2v concerns a phase-changing plant part at all; its picture is not newly examined and no aquatic/species identity is inherited.

That one repeated target construction is a phase guard with explicit state scope and a further construction expresses the maturity-plus-flower-fall boundary. Actual carriers, head/group granularity and full-clause boundaries remain to be authored.
That repeated part references preserve one physical carrier until a written change or participant switch; SAME versus NEW is an assumption, not a result of avoiding a collision.

The source root-food and seed-bread portions are not automatically required by any generic phase hypothesis. They become obligations only if the specific complete Pliny account is selected as the proposed content.
No old shol=MOIST, chol=DRY, qoty=COLD, daiin=quantity or chor=flower value is inherited as fact or silently repaired. A new content account must state what it retains or replaces.

The source uses plural heads and a flower expression. Choosing one individual head, a group, or a whole plant as the persisting carrier is an explicit granularity assumption. Never reopening after maturity alone is not a direct source entailment; the declared model would have to add and defend any strict cessation rule separately.
two_discriminating_consequences: A recurring phase construction must preserve its declared carrier across its written return clauses; a separately scoped boundary must express the source's maturity AND flower-fall conditions. This differs from merely adding OPEN/CLOSE words or choosing an arbitrary expiry number. Whether the model also denies all later opening is an extra C0 commitment, not a manuscript or source finding.

If both complete luminary rings and f2v are eventually authored under a common phase-reference rule, its temporal argument must remain an event/phase across those whole units. Neither an absolute celestial-body name nor a herb-name label can substitute freely for the phase relation. This is an optional future cross-unit consequence, not an alignment already found.
strongest_known_countercases: W96 already fixes SAME/NEW and MASS/GRADE rivals and parks them because their outcomes depend on free identity/scope choices. Supplying an unseen day/night event just to remove W96's static contradiction would repeat that stop. Only an actual written phase and terminal construction could justify a new selection.
GDT815/816 already show that plausible whole plant/part/quality accounts leave owners and predicate frames unbound, with94external contacts. Source biology cannot fill the unknown target predicates.

No current target group is bound to sunrise, sunset, maturity or flower fall; the source establishes a feasible story, not a completed target construction. W96 leaves20/21positions open under its own old guesses; this offer does not claim to reduce that count.
Pliny's Euphrates report differs from the preceding Egyptian report. Combining every attractive motion/food claim into one compulsory universal plant biography would overstate the primary.

The plural heads and flower wording does not itself prove modern anatomical identity or numerical single-head inventory. The hypothesis preserves a named carrier across phases at its chosen granularity and must state that granularity.

IDEA184 already rejects a free expiry duration as a discriminator; IDEA445 source review separates forecast scopes from added persistent-state identity. A plant daily cycle plus written until-clause is not their missing target binding. IDEA687 has no named illustrated source-and-organ mapping; this unillustrated ancient passage does not satisfy or reopen its pre1500 drawn two-structure gate.

IDEA680 already proposes the same flower opening by day and closing at night. General daily reversibility is not new. The additional input is this complete concrete source account, its separately scoped maturity-plus-flower-fall boundary and different part/report ownership; the old card is retained unchanged.

IDEA550 already authors a whole temporal UNTIL construction with repeated events but does not select UNTIL against AFTER without a stipulated source bridge. This new source cannot make a convenient source-order conflict into a target observation, and no chey value is imported.
